title: Night Scarb's measurements of the Osiris shaft scan

tellings.quote: So this is from a channel called Night Scarb who did measurements that show that the signatures are off and that the measurements don't exactly match the known configuration.

plain: Measurements from a scan of the Osiris shaft, a deep shaft beneath the Giza plateau in Egypt, are said to show readings that do not match what is known to be down there. The researcher Jeffrey Drum shows this on the show, crediting it to an online channel called Night Scarb that, he says, "did measurements that show that the signatures are off and that the measurements don't exactly match the known configuration." Drum offers it as a sign that something unknown may lie under the pyramids.
